title: Flat opcycles from universal tensor exactness on a ringed site
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site and $\mathcal O$ a sheaf of commutative rings. Let $P^\bullet$ be a cochain complex of sheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] whose terms are flat [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]. Fix an integer $n$. If for every sheaf of $\mathcal O$-modules $N$ the total tensor complex $\operatorname{Tot}(N\otimes_{\mathcal O}P^\bullet)$ [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves] is exact in degree $n-1$ [def-pc-acyclic-complex-modules], then the opcycle sheaf $Q^n=P^n/\operatorname{im}(d^{n-1}:P^{n-1}\to P^n)$ (the cokernel in the abelian category [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]) is flat over $\mathcal O$ [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules].

source.place: Tag 08G0 (sites-cohomology-lemma-last-one-flat), proof, cokernel/Tor argument; agent-written generalization to universal ordinary-tensor exactness, justified by the complete local diagram chase in report.md, not by assuming the source boundedness or Tor-amplitude hypotheses.

proof.text: Install the existing monoidal and symmetric structures for sheaves of O-modules. The two Nonempty factors of SheafOfModules.tensorClosed supply MonoidalPreadditive and MonoidalClosed for precisely this tensor product. The category ringedSiteModules is definitionally the Mathlib abelian category of module sheaves.

For each integer i, unfold the existing IsFlat hypothesis only to obtain PreservesFiniteLimits (tensorRight (P.X i)). Transport it along the inverse of BraidedCategory.tensorLeftIsoTensorRight. The proved upstream ObjectProperty.flat_iff_preservesFiniteLimits (WeilConjectures.CategoryTheory.Abelian.Flat.Basic) now gives ObjectProperty.flat (P.X i); closure supplies right exactness automatically.

For every test sheaf N, apply the proved upstream CochainComplex.mapBifunctorSingle₁Iso (WeilConjectures.FromJoel.Algebra.Homology.BifunctorSingle) to identify the total tensor of N[0] with P with termwise tensorLeft N applied to P. Compose with NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex of BraidedCategory.tensorLeftIsoTensorRight N. HomologicalComplex.ExactAt.of_iso transports the given exactness to the termwise tensorRight N complex, in exactly degree n-1.

Specialize the already proved upstream CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.flat_opcycles_of_exactAt (WeilConjectures.CategoryTheory.DerivedCategory.FlatModel, lines 74-165) to P and n, with the categorical flatness hypotheses at n-1 and n and the tensor-exactness just obtained. Its abelian refinement argument is exactly the cokernel-flatness diagram chase and requires no boundedness or enough-points hypothesis. The second conjunct of its conclusion is exactness of tensorRight (P.opcycles n), definitionally SheafOfModules.IsFlat (R := O) (P.opcycles n).

proof_origin.place: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.flat_opcycles_of_exactAt, lines 74-165; site specialization using tensorClosed, flat_iff_preservesFiniteLimits, mapBifunctorSingle₁Iso, and tensorLeftIsoTensorRight. This realizes the same Tag 08G0 cokernel-flatness argument without sectionwise lifts.
